title: Merge Settings
prompt: Write `mergeSettings(defaults, overrides)` that RETURNS a new object containing every key from `defaults` plus every key from `overrides`, with `overrides` values winning on conflicts. Neither input object may be mutated.

tests.name: overrides win on conflicts
tests.hint: Spread both objects into a new one, defaults first.

tests.name: extra override keys flow through
tests.hint: A single spread of each source handles both directions.

tests.name: neither input is mutated
tests.hint: Build a new object; never write into either argument.
